correctness.rationale: Correct by the augmented Lefschetz trace identity: each setwise-fixed face union of \(q\) vertex orbits contributes \((-1)^{q-1}\). The rotation orbit-conflict graph is an h-cycle (h=gcd), an edge for h=2, or empty for h=1; reflections give precisely path lengths specified by parity. Evaluating independence polynomials at -1 gives the formulas, and the published Proposition 26 establishes unique homology degree. The rational irreducibility and mod-12 invariant criterion follow from the exact characters. The bundled code independently enumerates all 336 dihedral group elements for sizes 3..18 and complete mod-two boundary ranks for 3..15. Finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The natural full dihedral action on homology is an intrinsic structural invariant of every matching complex of a cycle. The entire irreducible rational module is determined in all sizes, refining the known period-three nonequivariant sphere counts into a period-twelve fixed-homology distinction: a nonzero full-symmetry fixed line exists exactly for n congruent to 1 or 11 modulo 12. This resolves a substantive canonical equivariant classification rather than a numerical special case.
